linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04.6 LTS
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon™ RX 580 or equivalent
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard HD audio device
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04.6 LTS
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon™ RX 580 or equivalent
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard HD audio device

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4000 series or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 or equivalent

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 9000 series or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 or equivalent
  • Sound Card: Standard HD audio device
